title: Carved wood, iron straps and painted panels
body:
The Canal Townhouse door has carved timber panels, a brass knocker and a letter plate. At Orchard Cottage, a plank door hangs on two black iron hinges. Alpine Lodge has a barred window in its door, and the Scrappy Rowhouse has painted panels.

AgY modeled the doors. We baked the shallow details and ambient occlusion in Game Asset Prep and kept the frames, hinges and handles in the mesh.
